snippet.title: Heroes Together VR - Dev log trailer
snippet.description:
Heroes Together is a social-first co-op roguelite dungeon crawler where the run starts before you ever leave town. Hang out in a shared lobby packed with mini-games, then grab one of four hero classes and dive into chaotic, ever-changing dungeons. 

Built by an experienced team known for successful location-based VR escape room adventures, it’s tuned for voice chat, big co-op moments, and “one more run” nights. This trailer invites players to wishlist on Meta Quest and sign up for our early alpha to jump in with friends and help shape what Heroes Together becomes.

Wishlist on Meta: https://www.meta.com/en-gb/experiences/heroes-together-vr/27541833858794166
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3871970/Heroes_Together_VR/

Join the Discord: https://discord.gg/5KG86mKUFE
